# Retained Filee components

This directory contains MIT-licensed upstream source code from [KnifeLemon/Filee](https://github.com/KnifeLemon/Filee), retained only to implement DFTDesk's Windows file integration and Avalonia UI behavior. These sources are not presented as the DFTDesk application itself.

- `Core/`: underlying platform contracts and shared domain types
- `Platform.Windows/`: Windows Explorer and platform integration
- `App/Controls`, `App/Services`, `App/Styles`: donut menu, gesture and appearance components

The original source namespaces are kept intentionally for compatibility and provenance. No third-party copyright or licensing is waived.
